summary: Frontend-only regression test for FixitZ mobile web app. Verified: product detail Buy/Add-to-Cart buttons visible above bottom nav; Add-to-Cart toast; Buy Now -> /cart navigation; Cart bottom CTA visible; Flash Deals auto-scroll (scrollLeft changed 106->0 looping in 4s window); new Exclusive Discounts section rendered with 3 product cards and See all link; admin category Image URL inputs save and render on home; admin referralReward field saves with 'Settings updated' toast.

issues: Fixed checkout bar bottom-edge sits at y=832 while bottom nav starts at y=827 — the button itself (bottom=816) is clearly above the nav and clickable, but the bar background/rounded edge overlaps the top ~5px of the nav. Minor visual polish only.
